reason: The repository is primarily a developer-oriented agent plugin/skill package for Codex and DeepSeek Harness that standardizes how interactive frontend components are integrated, with explicit focus on fidelity, deviations tracking, and QA. Evidence from the manifest and distributed skill resources shows it is a runtime-installable skill module rather than a user-facing app feature.

summaries.zh: 这是一个可安装到 Codex/DeepSeek Harness 的智能体技能，面向前端交互组件（如 Canvas、WebGL、shader、滚动或指针驱动动画）提供集成与验收工作流。
summaries.en: This is an installable agent skill for Codex and DeepSeek Harness that provides an integration and verification workflow for interactive frontend components such as canvas, WebGL, shaders, and scroll- or pointer-driven animations.

capabilities: Registers as a DSH plugin bundle entry with runtime execution metadata
Guides agent-driven integration of third-party interactive frontend components (canvas/WebGL/shader/etc.)
Supports validation-focused checks such as rendering-fidelity and acceptance-state reporting

reasons.code: Plugin packaging is declared via package.json (main/module entry, exports, and dsh bundle patch) indicating runtime/plugin behavior rather than standalone app logic.

README explicitly scopes behavior to interactive component integration (canvas/WebGL/shader, scroll/pointer effects) and integration QA instructions.
